integrity: The universal argument is analytical. The bounded finite checker confirms examples and does not independently certify the proof or novelty.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the standard-isotypic Fourier coefficient block of the symmetric group and transposition sampling sites. Regular-graph spectral equivalence does not imply isomorphism reconstruction. Related classical incidence-frame formulations may remain unidentified.
title: Graph-spectral transfer for transposition sampling in the standard Fourier block of the symmetric group
